ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is the forecast map of high-temperature areas in China on July 29, 2013; the high-temperature shading mainly appears in parts of Xinjiang as well as the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River and the Jiangnan area; Changchun near Jilin in Northeast China is not covered by the high-temperature shading.
